primary_groups.Shipday: Workflows that fetch from / push to the Shipday delivery platform
primary_groups.Telnyx: Workflows that send SMS or receive inbound messages via Telnyx
primary_groups.Airtable: Workflows that read from or write to Airtable CRM
primary_groups.Google: Workflows that read from Google Docs or write to Google Drive
primary_groups.Orders: Order intake and daily CSV processing
primary_groups.Reporting: Daily reports generated by Claude and emailed
primary_groups.Instantly: Workflows that fetch analytics from or push leads/sequences to Instantly
primary_groups.Claude: Agent intelligence cycles — inference and routing logic in Python
primary_groups.System: Infrastructure: action queue executor, maintenance tasks

flow_types.Evidence: Pulls external data IN to Postgres (sensors)
flow_types.Action: Pushes data OUT to an external service
flow_types.Inference: Calls Python AI agents (Claude) for reasoning
flow_types.Decision: Runs lifecycle / routing rules (no external calls)
flow_types.Form: n8n form trigger for human input

airtable.note: API key stored in .env as AIRTABLE_API_KEY

telnyx.note: API key stored in .env as TELNYX_API_KEY

google.note: Google OAuth credentials stored in n8n credential store (Google Drive + Google Docs)

smtp.note: Gmail SMTP credential. Used by action_queue_executor for send_email_report and by broadcast_dispatch for email channel.

google_drive.note: Google Drive OAuth2. Used by action_queue_executor (upload_google_drive action) and google_docs_sync.

google_docs.note: Google Docs OAuth2. Used by google_docs_sync to read document content.

n8n.note: API key stored in .env as N8N_API_KEY

shipday_delivery_collector.name: [Shipday — Evidence] Delivery Collector
shipday_delivery_collector.note: Fetches orders from Shipday API and POSTs to POST /api/shipday/ingest-orders. Python never calls Shipday directly.

shipday_feedback_sync.name: [Shipday — Evidence] Feedback Sync
shipday_feedback_sync.note: Polls Shipday API for customer feedback, delivery instructions, proof-of-delivery. Stores in shipday_communications, fires delivery_update events.

shipday_historical_import.name: [Shipday — Evidence] Historical Import
shipday_historical_import.note: One-shot backfill: imports up to 1 year of Shipday order history. Run once to seed DB.

sms_dispatch.name: [Telnyx — Action] SMS Dispatch
sms_dispatch.note: Polls action_queue for send_sms actions and dispatches via Telnyx API

broadcast_dispatch.name: [Telnyx — Action] Broadcast Dispatch
broadcast_dispatch.note: Polls broadcast_recipients table and dispatches SMS (Telnyx) + email (SMTP)

broadcast_form.name: [Telnyx — Form] Broadcast Form
broadcast_form.note: n8n form UI for delay alerts and promo broadcasts. Calls Python API to create and queue the job.

airtable_outcome_sync.name: [Airtable — Evidence] Outcome Sync
airtable_outcome_sync.note: Pulls call outcomes from Airtable Field Sales Tasks and writes back to contacts

marketing_query_form.name: [Airtable — Inference] Marketing Query Form
marketing_query_form.note: n8n form → POST /api/query → Claude inference → logs answer to Airtable

campaign_performance_tracker.name: [Instantly — Evidence] Campaign Performance
campaign_performance_tracker.note: Fetches analytics per campaign from Instantly API, stores stats in DB

instantly_campaign_sync.name: [Instantly — Action] Campaign Sync
instantly_campaign_sync.note: Fetches Instantly campaigns tagged 'dabbahwala' and POSTs to POST /api/webhooks/sync-campaigns

instantly_setup.name: [Instantly — Action] Campaign Setup
instantly_setup.note: No-op if all campaigns already exist. Sets up missing campaigns in Instantly.

google_docs_sync.name: [Google — Evidence] Docs & Drive Sync
google_docs_sync.note: Reads Google Docs from Drive folder and pushes content to chatbot index. Uses Google Drive OAuth2 and Google Docs OAuth2 credentials.

daily_order_upload.name: [Orders — Action] Daily CSV Upload
daily_order_upload.note: Uploads CSV to POST /api/daily-orders/process. Response includes shipday_csv_download_url. Action queue handles Google Drive upload.

daily_activity_report.name: [Reporting — Inference] Daily Activity Report
daily_activity_report.note: Calls POST /api/agents/report/activity → Claude writes HTML + CSV → n8n emails to REPORT_EMAIL_TO

daily_outcome_report.name: [Reporting — Inference] Daily Outcome Report
daily_outcome_report.note: Calls POST /api/agents/report/outcome → Claude writes HTML + CSV → n8n emails to REPORT_EMAIL_TO

lifecycle_cycle_cron.name: [Claude — Decision] Lifecycle Cycle Runner
lifecycle_cycle_cron.note: Calls POST /api/lifecycle/run — pure rules-based lifecycle routing, no Claude call

lapsed_customer_cycle.name: [Claude — Decision] Lapsed Customer Daily Cycle
lapsed_customer_cycle.note: Persistent re-engagement cycle for lapsed customers. Infinite rotation with frequency escalation and creative copy variation.

action_queue_executor.name: [System — Action] Action Queue Executor
action_queue_executor.note: Central action hub. Routes pending action_queue rows to external APIs: Airtable (sync_airtable_task, log_query_to_airtable), Instantly (push_instantly_lead, push_instantly_sequences), Google Drive (upload_google_drive), SMTP (send_email_report), Telnyx (send_sms)

google_docs.note: Set up Google Drive + Google Docs OAuth2 credentials in n8n. Folder ID is hardcoded in workflow.

classification.ad_copy: Title contains: ad copy, social media, facebook, instagram, social post
classification.ground_note: Title contains: field note, ground, delivery note, driver (or default)
